title: tc-panel-dock
description: One side panel beside a chat with a tab per open item – resizable, collapsible to a rail, a full-width sheet when narrow.

items.description: The items open in the panel, in tab order

active.description: The shown item's id. Changed by the tabs unless a tc-active-change listener calls preventDefault()

open.description: Whether the panel shows at all. Closed by its Close button or Escape unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

collapsed.description: Folded to a rail of icons. Changed by Collapse and Expand unless a tc-collapsed-change listener calls preventDefault()

width.description: The panel's width, px. Changed by the splitter unless a tc-width-change listener calls preventDefault()

minWidth.description: The narrowest the splitter goes, px

maxWidth.description: The widest the splitter goes, px

breakpoint.description: Below this width of its parent, px, the panel becomes a full-width sheet over the page; 0 never

side.description: Which side of the chat the panel docks on – the splitter is on the other edge

labels.description: Rename any of the words, over the defaults

kind.description: What it is, in a word: "Artifact", "File", "Source", "Preview" – read with the title

icon.description: Lucide-style path data for its icon; a file icon when left out
